name: 55105 · Saint Paul, MN
findings: ZIP 55105 (Saint Paul) has 163 nonprofit organizations. 86 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 74 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 55105 (Saint Paul) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 55105 (Saint Paul) list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 12 organizations here; 31% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to take civic or political action so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
